records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: we Which of the following nerves is the afferent pathway of the gag reflex:
records.explanation: The glossopharyngeal nerve is the afferent pathway of the gag reflex. The vagus nerve is the efferent pathway of the gag reflex. Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: Ww A patient complains of headaches and dizziness. Imaging reveals a tumour at the cerebellopontine angle. Which of the following nerves will most likely be affected by this tumour:
records.explanation: The vestibulocochlear nerve and facial nerve both emerge from the brainstem at the cerebellopontine angle so are the nerves most likely to be affected by a tumour in this location. Vv
warnings: No marked correct option was detected.

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: Regarding the abducens nerve, which of the following statements is CORRECT:
options: The abducens nerve innervates the inferior oblique muscle. (<7 Abducens nerve palsy results in a vertical diplopia. 4%
The abducens nerve originates in the medulla.
The abducens nerve enters the orbit through the inferior orbital fissure.
Abducens nerve palsy results in a convergent squint.
records.explanation: The abducens nerve originates in the pons and enters the orbit through the superior orbital fissure to innervate the lateral rectus muscle. Abducens nerve palsy results in a convergent squint and horizontal diplopia. Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: A patient complains of diplopia and on examination is found to have a depressed and abducted eye with ptosis. Which of the following nerves is most likely to be affected:
options: Ophthalmic division of the trigeminal nerve
records.explanation: Oculomotor (CN III) nerve palsy results in a depressed and abducted (down and out) eye, diplopia, ptosis and a fixed and dilated pupil. Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: w The trochlear nerve innervates which of the following muscles:
records.explanation: The trochlear nerve innervates the superior oblique muscle of the eye. Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: w The spinal accessory nerve innervates which of the following muscles:
records.explanation: The accessory nerve innervates the sternocleidomastoid and the trapezius muscles. . Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: Ww Regarding the glossopharyngeal nerve, which of the following statements is INCORRECT:
options: The glossopharyngeal nerve originates from the medulla. 4% (x) The glossopharyngeal nerve emerges from the cranial cavity via the jugular foramen. 4%
The glossopharyngeal nerve is the efferent nerve of the gag reflex.
The glossopharyngeal nerve innervates the stylopharyngeus muscle.
The glossopharyngeal nerve supplies parasympathetic fibres to the parotid gland. 9%
records.explanation: The glossopharyngeal nerve is the afferent pathway of the gag reflex. The vagus nerve is the efferent pathway of the gag reflex. Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: A 64 year old man presents to ED complaining of diplopia. The image below shows the patient's eyes gazing straight ahead. Which of the following cranial nerves is affected:
options: Ophthalmic division of the trigeminal nerve 2%
records.explanation: Abducens nerve palsies result in a convergent squint at rest (eye turned inwards) with inability to abduct the eye because of unopposed action of the rectus medialis. The patient complains of horizontal diplopia when looking towards the affected side. With complete paralysis, the eye cannot abduct past the midline. Vv
